ai.title: RTX Spark Ignites Global Celebration as New Windows PCs Arrive
ai.brief: NVIDIA RTX Spark laptops are now available, bringing NVIDIA Blackwell RTX graphics, up to 128GB of unified memory and the full NVIDIA AI platform to slim, premium Windows PCs. Starting at $2,399, laptops from ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI bring powerful local AI, content creation and gaming capabilities to a portable device, with additional systems on the way. NVIDIA celebrated the launch with events around the world, including one in Berlin, where NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang made a surprise appearance. The arrival of RTX Spark brought fans, creators and PC enthusiasts together in Berlin during the Festival of Lights, an annual autumn art festival that transforms the German capital’s most famous landmarks, streets and squares into glowing canvases. This year, the festival featured RTX Spark-themed lighting on the Berlin TV Tower.

sec.title: Hackers Use Compromised ConnectWise Credential to Sign In to 173 Microsoft 365 Tenants
sec.brief: Cybersecurity researchers are sounding the alarm related to an active campaign in which unknown threat actors are abusing a compromised Microsoft 365 (M365) credential belonging to ConnectWise Cloud Backup (formerly SkyKick) to gain unauthorized access to customers' M365 environments.
